about:
Midwest Metal Fabrications has operated from Tallmadge, Ohio, for over 40 years. The company describes its origins as a hands-on partnership with customers, not merely a vendor relationship, a mindset that has driven steady growth. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides laser cutting up to 1-inch thick on a 5-by-10-foot table, press braking with 243 tons across a 14-foot opening, AWS-certified welding of stainless, aluminum, and carbon steel, CNC shearing on a 10-foot-wide shear, and CNC milling and turning from prototype through production. Metal finishing — powder coating, zinc plating, and galvanizing — is outsourced to qualified partners. Custom products include NEMA enclosures, weldments, steel bollards, and rack systems. The workforce averages 16 years of tenure; headcount and facility size are not published.

Customers span aerospace, automation, data centers, electrical contractors, food and beverage, housing, integrators, last-mile trucking, machine builders, manufacturing, nuclear, power, and transportation. Wind-energy components are also noted. The firm primarily serves Northeast Ohio — Akron, Cleveland, Canton, Columbus, Cincinnati, Toledo — but ships nationwide. Testimonials cite an Akron electrical contractor and Bevcorp in Eastlake as repeat clients.

The company emphasizes its collaborative approach and long-tenured team as differentiators. It holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 certifications, and promotes competitive pricing, reliable turnaround, and a partner-oriented attitude — treating customers as partners rather than purchase orders. All work is performed in the USA.
